name: com.ezg.ezgkit
description: One-window Unity Editor setup kit that walks a new project through its per-project configuration in the order it must happen. Sidebar splits into two groups: Setup Ezg and Publishers (one tab per SDK set — Ezg in-house default, Neptune CPI test, SayGame placeholder — showing required vs installed vs extra SDKs and which IDs to change where, with a one-click Switch that caches and removes extra SDKs, installs missing ones, writes publisher IDs and toggles EZG_SDK_* defines; add a profile class to add a publisher). Setup Ezg ships five tabs: Marketing (pull a Google Sheet of store/ads identifiers and write them into PlayerSettings, AdsConfig, AppLovinSettings, FacebookSettings, AndroidManifest and GameConstant.cs), Firebase (pick a service-account .json, provision the Android + iOS apps, then download google-services.json / GoogleService-Info.plist), Social (Discord invite / support link / support email into GameConstant, plus a scan for hardcoded links and leaked Discord tokens), IAP (read the SKUs the client actually registers by calling ShopService.GetAllProductId() through reflection, enrich them from the project's pack collection assets, and reconcile them against the products that really exist on App Store Connect / Google Play through an internal read-only API — every check is cached to Library/ so reopening the tab costs no network call), and Readiness (Ready / Warning / Error board for IAP SKUs, Firebase config, ads/attribution SDK keys and store/build settings, with a copy-for-PM text report). Opening the window only ever reads; every write sits behind an explicit button. Also ships the shared EzgKitStyles / SetupGui drawing toolkit and the IEzgKitPage contract so a project can add its own setup tab.
